question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

To keep postponing doing a task later because you’re lazy
solution:
The correct answer is **'procrastinate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We need to substitute one word for **'To keep postponing doing a task later because you’re lazy' **from the given options :
 
• Let's explore the meanings:
 
 
• **Procrastinate** means putting off till another day or time, doing something that you should do because you do not want to do it. (जी चुराना, टालना)
 
• **Multi-task **means doing several different jobs at the same time. (बहु कार्य)
 
• **Leave **means go away from; depart from permanently. (स्थायी रूप से प्रस्थान करना)
 
• **Diligent **means showing care and effort in your work or duties. (परिश्रमी, सावधान और कर्मठ)
 
 
 
• From the given meanings of the given options, only '**Procrastinate**' is the one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** option 1.**
